ui.shownWhen: Use: completed tuple/strict bindings unavailable; no transaction
ui.text:
[Winter relief unavailable]

Finish the Greenwater road first. Relief also needs verified Corn and caps records and a consistent completed cargo account. No food, money or river result was changed.

ui.shownWhen: BlockRequest: immediate request could not be acknowledged, same epoch only
ui.text:
[Food request unavailable]

This request could not be safely confirmed. It will not be retried or refunded automatically. Other relief changes are blocked; you can still inspect the ledger. Keep this save for diagnosis.

ui.shownWhen: Use: persisted unresolved operation; inspection permitted, effects forbidden
ui.text:
[Relief request held]

An earlier request is unresolved. No further donation, purchase or local step can run. Inspect the current ledger?

ui.shownWhen: Use: steps0..5, no pending operation
ui.text:
[Winter relief]

Your river decision remains unchanged. Bring real Corn here or buy a finite batch at Mercy's supply shelter. Nothing runs down while you are away.

ui.shownWhen: Use: six steps with unresolved shortfall; no advance
ui.text:
[Six relief steps accounted for]

No seventh step or new stock period exists. Outstanding need can still be cleared with real Corn. Earlier hunger remains in the record.

ui.shownWhen: Shop: finite current-period stock; buying is not donation
ui.text:
[Mercy relief supply]

Buy 10 Corn for 20 caps. Stock this period: %g Corn of 30. Buying is NOT a donation; carry it to Greenwater. Scavenged or grown Corn works too.

ui.shownWhen: ShowStatus: step/reserve/debt/remaining demand/donated units
ui.text:
[Current relief stores]

Step %g of 6. Reserve: %g units. Shortfall: %g. Remaining demand: %g. Donated: %g units. Each planned step costs 150. Ten units represent one provisioning day; this is a simplified ledger.

ui.shownWhen: ShowStatus: balance covers remaining demand including debt
ui.text:
[Relief forecast]

Covered for the remaining planned steps. This is the bounded ledger's forecast, not a promise of universal town prosperity or erased past hunger.

ui.shownWhen: ShowStatus: balance below remaining demand
ui.text:
[Food still needed]

More food is needed before winter is covered. Shortfall means unmet need, not a recorded death toll. You can return with Corn. Nothing runs down by waiting or leaving.

ui.shownWhen: ShowStatus: everShortfall latched by an actual local step
ui.text:
[Earlier hunger remains]

A previous local step recorded a shortage. Aid clears current shortfall first, but cannot undo earlier hunger. No famine deaths have been inferred.

ui.shownWhen: Donate: real inventory >=10; quantity1/5/10/cancel
ui.text:
[Choose Corn quantity]

Only actual Corn removed from your inventory is credited. Each Corn adds 10 relief units; you keep the rest.

ui.shownWhen: Donate: inventory5..9; quantity1/5/cancel
ui.text:
[Choose Corn quantity]

Each Corn adds 10 relief units. You do not currently hold 10 Corn.

ui.shownWhen: Donate: inventory1..4; quantity1/cancel
ui.text:
[Choose Corn quantity]

You have fewer than 5 Corn. One actual Corn can add 10 relief units.

ui.shownWhen: Donate: no actual Corn inventory
ui.text:
[No Corn to donate]

No Corn is available in your inventory. Gather, grow or bring Corn later; buying food is optional. Nothing was taken.

ui.shownWhen: Donate: exact quantity/clear-debt/new-reserve before persisted request/effect
ui.text:
[Donate food?]

Give %g Corn from your inventory to the town stores. Each item is consumed once. This clears %g shortfall and adds %g reserve units. You keep the rest.

ui.shownWhen: Donate: immediate active-request exact decrease and one committed credit
ui.text:
[Food received]

Your actual Corn contribution was consumed and credited once. Inspect the reserve to see current need. Your earlier river decision and any past hunger remain unchanged.

ui.shownWhen: Shop: real20caps/finite10Corn; before persisted request/debit
ui.text:
[Buy relief food?]

Pay 20 real caps for 10 actual Corn. This uses 10 of the current period's finite 30 stock. The town receives nothing until you donate the food at Greenwater.

ui.shownWhen: Shop: immediate acknowledged debit AND delivery; no donation credit
ui.text:
[Food purchased]

20 caps paid; 10 Corn received. Town reserves did not change. Carry the food to Greenwater's separate winter-relief stores control to contribute it.

ui.shownWhen: Shop: insufficient finite stock/caps or checked Corn inventory ceiling
ui.text:
[Purchase unavailable]

Stock or caps are insufficient, or your Corn inventory is at this prototype's safety limit. Nothing was taken. Gathered and grown Corn remain valid donations.

ui.shownWhen: Advance: explicit local-only15day accounting; exact projected reserve/debt
ui.text:
[Advance local relief step?]

This accounts for 15 days of town provisions only; it does NOT move the game's clock. Demand: 150 units. Projected reserve: %g; shortfall: %g. Nothing advances unless you confirm.

ui.shownWhen: Advance: one committed local150unit step; stock renews only1..5
ui.text:
[Local relief step recorded]

One 15-day provision step was accounted for. No global time or other quest changed. Inspect the ledger for current need; real Corn can clear a shortage later.

ui.shownWhen: Donate/Advance: after newly completed six-step/debt-clear ledger and acknowledgement
ui.text:
[Bounded winter relief covered]

All six local steps are accounted for and outstanding shortfall is clear. Earlier hunger, the original grain outcome and any lie remain part of the record. Coverage does not mean nobody suffered.

ui.shownWhen: Use: completed bounded season; inspection only, no new effects
ui.text:
[Winter relief ledger covered]

All six local steps and current shortfall are covered. This bounded season has no further donation, purchase or advance. Earlier hunger and your original river decision remain in the record.

reviewRepair.judgmentConsent: Original speaker, prisoner, required recipient/object and road stamp captured before the initiating choice; passed through confirmation and validated against actual authoritative aliases at effect and yielding receipt boundaries. No replacement actor selected.
reviewRepair.hangingReceipt: HangActor retains the captured execution actor; observed death is attributed to that actual actor, never a dead replacement alias. Genuine already-issued effects remain facts.
reviewRepair.reliefPages: Originating activation epoch is passed through all later pages. UseCurrent reads native local control context first and validates the captured generation last. Mutable newer requestEpoch cannot reauthorize an old frame.
reviewRepair.evidence: Actual PSC plus explicitly seeded alias changes/load/native scheduling; not a game observation. Original reports, source and probes preserved; no native measurements inferred.
